summary:
Chartered Accountant possessing a solid foundation in Financial Accounting, Auditing and Taxation (Both Personal and
Corporate) . Detail-oriented and experienced tax professional with expertise in U.S. and Canadian taxation, including corporate,
personal, and cross-border tax compliance. Skilled in preparing financial statements, corporate and personal tax returns, and
ensuring compliance with CRA and IRS regulations. Proficient in tax software such as Profile, Drake, Xero, and QuickBooks.
Adept at implementing tax-saving strategies and providing expert client support for complex cross-border tax matters.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Excel→Microsoft Excel(100%), PowerPoint→Microsoft PowerPoint(100%), taxation→Taxation(100%), QuickBooks.→QuickBooks(95%))

bullets: Prepare and finalize financial statements for U.S. and Canadian corporations using Excel, Xero, and Quick-books, ensuring full compliance with CRA regulations and IRS regulations.
Prepare corporate tax returns (T2) for Canadian clients using Profile, ensuring adherence to Canadian tax rules and regulations.
Prepare LLC tax returns (Form 1065) for U.S. LLCs using Drake tax software, ensuring compliance with IRS regulations and accurate reporting of partnership income, deductions, and distributions.
Prepare U.S. and Canadian personal tax returns for cross-border clients, applying effective tax-saving strategies to optimize tax liabilities in both jurisdictions.

Supported the implementation of cross-border tax strategies for clients, including joint and separate returns, Form 2555 for foreign earned income exclusion, Foreign Tax Credit (FTC), and dual status or normal tax status filings.
Contribute to the preparation of PST monthly returns for Canadian corporations, ensuring accurate filings and timely submissions.
Provided client support during tax filings, addressing queries related to cross-border taxation and helping clients navigate Canadian and U.S. tax requirements.
Prepared S216 returns, NR(S217) returns, T1 returns along with departure tax forms for Canadian clients.
Prepared US tax returns, including 1040 (MFJ, MFS), W7 applications, Form 114, and Dual Status returns for US clients.
Prepared financial statements for proprietorship, partnerships, and companies using Tally and Busy.
Filed GSTR-3B, GSTR-1, and annual GST returns and prepared reconciliation statements and assisted in GST audits.
Supported tax audit processes by drafting tax audit reports and coordinating with auditors.
Handled core accounting functions such as bookkeeping, ledger scrutiny, journal entries, and bank reconciliations.
Created reconciliation statements for annual GST returns and assisted in GST audits.

bullets: Managed end-to-end Preparation and filing of GST Returns, including conducting GST Audit in Compliance with Act and Rules and Regulations.
Prepared and Filed Income Tax Returns for Individuals and Partnership Firms, ensuring accuracy and adherence to Tax Regulations.
Prepared Reconciliation Statements between Financial Statements and GST Returns and make replies for such discrepancies and reconciled them thereafter.
Conducted GST Audit Assignments to ensure Compliance and Accuracy.
Conducted verification of Transactions and Ledger Scrutiny, including Bank Reconciliations.
Formulated and executed the Preparation of Tax Audit Reports (Forms 3CA, 3CB and 3CD) for clients as per Regulatory Requirements.
Contributed to tax planning strategies that optimized client tax liabilities and ensured compliance with regulations.
Supported the development and implementation of tax planning strategies, resulting in optimized tax savings for clients.
Collaborated on Income Tax Audits for clients in the Mineral and Textile Industries, ensuring thorough Compliance and accurate Reporting.
Prepared and Reviewed Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Statement in accordance with Schedule III, ensuring financial accuracy.
